card.name: Closing words like possible, all, altogether
card.fires_on: The word that completes an intensifying phrase, mainly "possible" after "the shortest" and "all" or "altogether" at the end of a clause. The next word is usually a noun or the end of the sentence.

modes.label: shortest possible
modes.description: "possible" after "the shortest" in advice about using the lowest dose for the shortest time.
modes.example: the lowest effective dose should be used for the shortest<< possible>> duration.

modes.label: at all / altogether
modes.description: "all" or "altogether" ending a clause with a negative or removal sense.
modes.example: Smart-phone users couldn’t remember much at<< all>>, which is another of way saying that

card.writes: It pushes against "alone" and "altogether"-type words, so the model does not add another emphasis word after the phrase.
card.plain: It marks the last word of phrases like "shortest possible" or "not at all", where the phrase is already complete.
